SimCity Societies - What Kinds of Cities Would You Build? (Video)

Andy CASA, UCL East

Coming in November from EA is the latest incarnation of the SimCity franchise - SimCity Societies. EA have released a couple of teasers for the game via YouTube, as embedded below:

Teaser 1:




Teaser 2:


The game includes (according to EA) an all-new, revolutionary feature set, SimCity Societies allows you to create your own kinds of cities and shape their cultures and environments. Make your cities green or polluted, contemporary or futuristic, rural or urban. Create an artistic society or a police state, an industrial city or a spiritual community—or any society you want!

We will be running a full feature on SimCity Societies closer to its release date.
